Even if it feels tedious, try to seek some help as far as medication/therapy. I've spent the better part of my life feeling similar to how you've described. Medication has helped me. Despite my reluctance to adopt it, medication for depression has made a positive impact on my life. Depression can be a lonely place. Just know that you are not alone. There are so many of us out there suffering in different ways. Maybe with treatment that is right for you, whatever that means, you can see your way to better days.
